name: Spike - repeated session types in one launch
notes: Asks whether AC will take two TYPE=3 races in a single launch, with a qualifying between them, so a sprint plus feature weekend can share one launch instead of splitting into two. Watch whether Content Manager accepts the URI at all, whether the in-game session list shows all four, and whether you can advance from the sprint into the second qualifying without dropping back to the menu. The two races are deliberately different lengths - sprint 2, feature 4 - which also settles the separate LAPS question: we write both [SESSION_n] LAPS and [RACE] RACE_LAPS, and RACE_LAPS carries the first race session's 2. So 2 then 4 means AC reads the session; 2 then 2 means it reads [RACE] and per-session lengths are not expressible.
